examples.name: Example authorizations
examples.description: This query will return a list of authorizations for a merchant.

examples.name: Create an authorization
examples.query:
mutation CreateAuthorization(
  $merchant_uid: String!
  $amount: Int!
  $payment_method: PaymentMethodInput
  $fee_mode: FeeMode
) {
  createAuthorization(
    merchant_uid: $merchant_uid
    amount: $amount
    payment_method: $payment_method
    fee_mode: $fee_mode
  ) {
    authorization_id
    merchant_uid
    amount
    currency
    status
    fee_mode
    fees
    authorization_date
    expiration_date
    sale_id
  }
}
examples.description: Places a hold on a card for a future capture.

examples.name: Example createWalletAuthorization
examples.description: This call is used to create an authorization for a wallet payment via Apple Pay or Google Pay. It works in conjunction with our SDKs to allow you to create an authorization via our API.

examples.name: Capture an authorization
examples.description: Captures the amount held by an authorization.

examples.name: Amount is too high
examples.description: Returns an error when the capture amount exceeds the authorization and reauthorization is not allowed.

examples.name: Capture above the authorization amount
examples.description: Allows a capture above the original authorization amount by creating a new authorization for the capture.
examples.query:
mutation CreateCapture(
  $merchant_uid: String!
  $authorization_id: String!
  $amount: Int!
  $allow_exceeded_amount: Boolean
) {
  createCapture(
    merchant_uid: $merchant_uid
    authorization_id: $authorization_id
    amount: $amount
    allow_exceeded_amount: $allow_exceeded_amount
  ) {
    transaction_id
    merchant_uid
    gross_amount
    net_amount
    status
    fee_mode
    authorization_id
  }
}
